name: What is the typical process for commercial water damage cleanup?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for commercial water damage cleanup?

acceptedAnswer.text: Commercial water damage cleanup typically involves several steps: initial assessment and damage evaluation, water extraction using powerful pumps, thorough drying and dehumidification of the structure, cleaning and sanitizing affected materials, and final moisture checks. This systematic approach ensures all moisture is removed to prevent mold growth and further structural issues.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes assessment, water extraction, drying, sanitizing, and final moisture checks to prevent mold.
